presentation.label: Presentation
presentation.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the Fleur d'AmOurs Ecosystem
presentation.welcomeSubtitle: Mapping the Invisible, Harmonising the Living
presentation.intro: The Fleur d'AmOurs is a living mirror designed to reveal the health of your bonds — whether a relationship, a project, or your own inner alignment. Through the geometry of its 8 Petals, it decodes the energies at work — from the desire that drives action to the security that stabilises, up to the meaning that guides movement.
presentation.aiDesc: Natural dialogue and deep analysis. Ask your questions to the intelligence connected to the science of the Flower: it instantly identifies areas of fluidity and systemic knots, offering you a precise reading of your current situation.
presentation.aiTagline: Guided Garden of Love session · 4 doors · Personalised 14-day plan
presentation.tarotIntro: Consult the structure for immediate guidance:
presentation.tarotCardDesc: The central energy, the 'Heart' of the moment.
presentation.tarotDoorsDesc: The obligatory passage points for the evolution of your system:
presentation.tarotDoor2Desc: What needs to be set in motion.
presentation.tarotDoor3Desc: The challenge or transition to integrate.
presentation.tarotDoor4Desc: The resolution or fulfilment you are moving towards.
presentation.closing: Nourish your relationships. Clarify your ambitions. Harmonise your system.
presentation.gardenFeatureTitle: Garden of Love — Explore my Flower
presentation.gardenFeatureDesc: A session guided by an AI Tutor through the 4 doors (Heart, Time, Climate, History). Share what is alive in you, reveal your Fleur d'AmOurs Tarot cards, note your reflections and receive a personalised 14-day plan. Resume an ongoing session or start a new one.
presentation.tiragesFeatureDesc: Draw a card or launch a 4-Door reading. Each Fleur d'AmOurs Tarot card opens a reflection on your relational dynamics and a personalised synthesis.
presentation.disclaimer: This tool is not therapeutic or an oracle. It is a compassionate mirror that helps you see what you already know.

fleurZen.briefLocalAspirationsEmpty: Your intentions and reflections, through draws and sessions, will gradually clarify what you aspire to live and build.

petalIntent.agape: How can I welcome a more unconditional quality of love in what I’m living right now?
petalIntent.philautia: What is nourishing or straining my relationship with myself today — and what can I notice without judgment?
petalIntent.mania: Where do fusion, demands, or jealousy tint my attachments — and what can I acknowledge?
petalIntent.storge: Which bonds of trust, everyday tenderness, or loyalty want to be honored here?
petalIntent.pragma: What structure, commitment, or clarity is missing for things to move forward in a grounded way?
petalIntent.philia: What is friendship, camaraderie, or loyalty inviting me to see in this situation?
petalIntent.ludus: Where could playfulness, lightness, or flirt bring breath or movement back into my story?
petalIntent.eros: What desire, chemistry, or passion is trying to speak through this question?

landing.accessSubtitle: Individuals, practitioners, and companies: three entry points for one relational ecosystem.
landing.accessIndividualBody: Clarify a relationship situation, draw a card if you wish, then continue with deeper tools and practical guidance.
landing.accessCoachBody: See how the garden supports your accompaniment framework, relationship quality, and between-session follow-up.
landing.accessCompanyBody: A relational framework for organizations: connecting people, teams, and interaction quality over time.
landing.individualSectionLead: Card drawing remains available here as a clarity entry point inside a broader pathway.
landing.socialProofIntro: Voices along the path: clarity, decisions, and possible steps—not only a single card.
landing.socialQuote1: "In one card, I finally found words for what I was feeling."
landing.socialQuote2: "I needed to stop going in circles. The path helped me make a real choice—without judging myself."
landing.socialQuote3: "It's not a magic answer—but I have direction and concrete threads to lean on when things wobble."
landing.trustLine: Secure connection · Your data is respected · No card required to explore
landing.visualTeaserTitle: The garden is more than one card
landing.visualTeaserBody: Guided paths, saved readings, your Flower, inner conversations, and clarity tools: a full space opens when you sign up—free to start.
landing.visualTeaserCta: Create an account and open the garden
landing.visualTeaserAria: Visual preview of the Fleur d'AmOurs garden
landing.visualTeaserAlt: App preview: Fleur d'AmOurs eight-petal view and journal of shadows and lights with reading history
landing.heroTitle: Navigate the complexity of your loves
landing.heroSubtitle: A compassionate mirror that invites movement: give shape to what is happening in your relationships, then find support to decide, adjust, and transform what you are going through.
landing.heroAccountHook: Create a free account to open the full garden: guided paths, saved readings, AI insights, and support—from first clarity to the choices and actions that are possible for you.
landing.accountVsTitle: This page or the whole tool?
landing.accountVsBody: Here, one card to clarify. With an account, you chain the tools to sustain the shift: save, go deeper, and lean on concrete next steps—pick up anytime.
landing.benefitClarityTitle: From fog to a clear frame
landing.benefitClarityDesc: A path and questions that help you name what matters and make calmer, clearer choices.
landing.benefitReadingsDesc: Revisit your steps, summaries, and markers to track what changes over time.
landing.benefitMirrorDesc: Readings grounded in the Fleur d'AmOurs tarot and your situation—to open levers, not only images.
landing.benefitJourneyDesc: Plans and follow-ups to go beyond a single spotlight moment and anchor gestures over time.
landing.benefitSpaceDesc: Flower, pairs, favorites—your relationships, threads, and how you evolve, in one place.
landing.benefitHumanTitle: Human support when you want it
landing.benefitHumanDesc: A person to talk with when you want to move from insight to human accompaniment.
landing.ritualHeroTitle: Ask your question. The card answers.
landing.ritualHeroSubtitle: A simple ritual to clarify what you're going through — then open the full garden if it resonates.
landing.intentionPlaceholder: What question or situation brings you here today?

landing.proTeaserLead: The Fleur d'AmOurs tarot and the digital garden support your practice: relational insight, shared language, and clearer follow-up.
landing.proTeaserBulletA: A powerful between-sessions tool (cards, paths, resources)
landing.proTeaserBulletB: Messaging and a dedicated space to track your accompaniments
landing.footerNote: Fleur d'AmOurs — Clarity and relational transformation

coachLanding.metaDesc: Fleur d'AmOurs for coaches and therapists: relational tarot, guided session, manual, messaging, and space to run accompaniments.
coachLanding.heroTitle: The garden at the service of your practice
coachLanding.heroSubtitle: Fleur d'AmOurs connects a finely crafted relational and symbolic tool with an app that structures how you work with the people you accompany—individuation, self-connection, relational issues: one ecosystem.
coachLanding.pillarToolDesc: Cards, essences, root questions, door paths, inner conversation, online manual: a shared vocabulary to explore emotional and relational layers without carrying all the verbal load alone.
coachLanding.pillarPracticeTitle: Bring clarity to how you run your practice
coachLanding.pillarPracticeDesc: Built-in messaging, accompaniment requests, practitioners directory, and—for enabled accounts—overview of conversations and caseload: less scatter across email, SMS, and loose notes.
coachLanding.b1Title: Fleur d'AmOurs map, pairs, and favorites
coachLanding.b1Desc: A living map of bonds and tensions: a hinge for sessions and for work between appointments.
coachLanding.b2Desc: Structured paths, simple or deep draws, history: people move with landmarks; you share material to go further together.
coachLanding.b3Desc: Card meanings and concepts inside the app: ground your work in a coherent grid of reading.
coachLanding.b4Desc: Space for symbolism and inner exploration, alongside explicit relational work.
coachLanding.b5Desc: People can reach out from the product; directory visibility links your practice to the garden.
coachLanding.b6Desc: Dashboard, conversations, follow-up: when your role is enabled, you run accompaniment-related activity in a dedicated frame.
coachLanding.disclaimerDesc: Fleur d'AmOurs is a clarity and exploration tool. It extends your professional frame; it does not replace your expertise or your legal and ethical duties. Supportive wording features are not medical or psychological diagnosis.
coachLanding.ctaLead: Create an account to explore the tool with the same depth as the people you accompany, or sign in if you already have access.
coachLanding.footerNote: Fleur d'AmOurs — Relational tool and digital space for practitioners

myceliumLanding.metaDesc: Mycelium, the company dimension of Fleur d'AmOurs: a relational framework to support individual, team, and managerial accompaniment.
myceliumLanding.heroTitle: Mycelium: the relational framework for companies
myceliumLanding.heroSubtitle: Like the underground network that connects living systems, Mycelium links people, accompaniment practices, and organizational stakes to support durable transformation.
myceliumLanding.p1Desc: A shared language and reference points for people, teams, and managers.
myceliumLanding.p2Desc: From relational diagnosis to concrete plans, Mycelium structures the shift from understanding to daily actions.
myceliumLanding.p3Desc: A framework to circulate relational quality without relying on isolated initiatives.
myceliumLanding.ctaLead: Create an account to follow the company release and access the first features as they become available.
myceliumLanding.footerNote: Mycelium by Fleur d'AmOurs — Relational framework for companies
